mutants.desc: set-but-unusable env (blank/";;") counts as "env set": refusal skipped and the FILE roots used
env set: env roots MERGED with the refused file roots
an allowedDownloadRoots option that is present but empty/null skips the refusal (file roots used)
MCP only: refusal not passed to the resolver (pre-fix composition)
SDK only: refusal not passed to the resolver
CLI resolver: download <dir> is NOT treated as a higher layer (refusal still raised)
CLI resolver: download <dir> clears the refusal but KEEPS the file roots (merged with <dir>)
central: fsRootsConfigLayer drops downloadRefusal on every surface
over-refusal: an EXPLICIT (SUTRADHAR_CONFIG) file is also refused
an UPLOAD-roots env var skips the DOWNLOAD refusal
CLI entry (cli.ts): withSession does not hand <dir> to the resolver (download <dir> not a higher layer, real CLI only)
blank env becomes "default roots": refusal skipped by a set-but-empty env (roots not the file's)

F3 re-check: inHome from the canonical cwd only (pre-fix)
